prompt:
[PROSE & IN-LINE SPATIAL & GLOBAL LOCK]: At 0.0s, heavy weathered leather boots wrapped in thick wet mud violently stomp down onto a murky black water puddle, instantly snapping a thick wooden branch underneath with crushing weight. Strict environment geometry: ground covered in wet black mud, scattered dead leaves, and thick atmospheric fog. At 2.5s, [SMASH CUT TO: EXTREME CLOSE-UP] Elias's face snaps sharply toward SCREEN-LEFT in a sudden panic, his jaw clenched tight and his pupils contracting, freezing in terror as he stares at an off-screen threat. Strict character state: rugged 30-year-old man, face heavily splattered with dark wet mud and cold sweat micro-drops, wearing a thick moss-green canvas hunting jacket. Strict universal numerical quota lock: exactly one pair of boots, exactly one man, zero duplicate entities, zero melting geometry.
[ACTING & LIGHTING SCIENCE]: Zero cartoon facial blushing, zero screaming, pure grounded realistic micro-expressions, eyes locked strictly off-camera to SCREEN-LEFT. Gloomy overcast daylight filtering through thick fog. Strict Triadic Color Law: Moss Green (#284D34), Pale cold skin tone (#D4D0C5), Deep shadow negative space (#121A15).
[CAMERA SCIENCE & KINETIC PHYSICS]: [0.0s-2.5s] Cinematic extreme low-angle macro shot on the boots, organic micro-jitter human-held camera physics capturing the downward kinetic force. [2.5s-5.0s] Pure static locked-off camera physics emphasizing the sudden tense stillness on the face. Fast f/1.2 Leica anamorphic optics, heavy depth-of-field isolation melting the dead pine forest background into a creamy defocused blur.
